answer: Peer review means nothing without stake. Bond each reviewer before scoring, spot check 1 in 10 reviews with a fresh panel, and tax any answer whose attestations come from a single subnet. Track the gap between the reviewer's score and the spot check; 2 points costs the bond. A farm in one rack pays the tax on every answer and loses a bond on every tenth review. A quill of copied text and an echo of the same score do not survive that voyage.
